    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    key = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and k.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if not key:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "no active API key available for this workspace.")
    api_key_id = key.get("id")

    if ws.get("allow_web_search") is not True:
        runs = _load("query_runs.json")
        run_id = "vxs_run_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        run_row = {
            "id": run_id,
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "get_doc_snippets",
            "status": "failed",
            "query": query,
            "topic": topic,
            "tech_stack": None,
            "use_web_search": True,
            "model_name": (model_name.strip() if isinstance(model_name, str) and model_name.strip() else ws.get("vertex_model")),
            "prompt_tokens": None,
            "completion_tokens": None,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "answer_text": None,
            "error_code": "web_search_disabled",
            "error_message": "Web search is disabled for this workspace.",
            "output_file_id": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        runs.append(run_row)
        _save("query_runs.json", runs)
        return {"query_run": run_row, "web_sources": []}

    # Quota enforcement
    def _today_utc():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat()

    last_used = key.get("last_used_at")
    if isinstance(last_used, str) and len(last_used) >= 10 and last_used[:10] != _today_utc():
        key["requests_today"] = 0
    if not isinstance(key.get("requests_today"), int) or key.get("requests_today") < 0:
        key["requests_today"] = 0

    limit = key.get("daily_request_limit_override")
    if limit is None:
        limit = ws.get("max_requests_per_day", 0)
    if key["requests_today"] + 1 > limit:
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        runs = _load("query_runs.json")
        run_id = "vxs_run_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
        run_row = {
            "id": run_id,
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "get_doc_snippets",
            "status": "failed",
            "query": query,
            "topic": topic,
            "tech_stack": None,
            "use_web_search": True,
            "model_name": (model_name.strip() if isinstance(model_name, str) and model_name.strip() else ws.get("vertex_model")),
            "prompt_tokens": None,
            "completion_tokens": None,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "answer_text": None,
            "error_code": "quota_exceeded",
            "error_message": "Daily request quota exceeded.",
            "output_file_id": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        runs.append(run_row)
        _save("query_runs.json", runs)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily request quota exceeded.", query_run=run_row)

    key["requests_today"] += 1
    key["last_used_at"] = now
    key["updated_at"] = now
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    chosen_model = (model_name.strip() if isinstance(model_name, str) and model_name.strip() else ws.get("vertex_model"))
    if chosen_model not in ("gemini-1.5-pro-latest",):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsupported model_name.")

    runs = _load("query_runs.json")
    run_id = "vxs_run_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
    run_row = {
        "id": run_id,
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_id,
        "tool_name": "get_doc_snippets",
        "status": "running",
        "query": query,
        "topic": topic,
        "tech_stack": None,
        "use_web_search": True,
        "model_name": chosen_model,
        "prompt_tokens": None,
        "completion_tokens": None,
        "latency_ms": None,
        "answer_text": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "output_file_id": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    runs.append(run_row)
    _save("query_runs.json", runs)

    web_sources = _load("web_sources.json")
    anchored = f"{topic.strip()} {query.strip()}"
    created_sources = []
    for i in range(max_sources):
        rank = i + 1
        src_id = "vxs_src_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f") + f"_{rank}"
        url_q = re.sub(r"\s+", "+", anchored)
        created_sources.append({
            "id": src_id,
            "query_run_id": run_id,
            "rank": rank,
            "url": f"https://docs.example.com/snippets?q={url_q}&r={rank}",
            "title": f"Docs snippet source {rank}: {topic.strip()[:50]}",
            "snippet": f"Snippet {rank} for “{query.strip()[:80]}”.",
            "is_official_doc": True,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        })
    existing_ranks = {(s.get("query_run_id"), s.get("rank")) for s in web_sources}
    for row in created_sources:
        if (row["query_run_id"], row["rank"]) in existing_ranks:
            continue
        web_sources.append(row)
    _save("web_sources.json", web_sources)

    sources_for_run = [s for s in _load("web_sources.json") if s.get("query_run_id") == run_id]
    if len(sources_for_run) < 1:
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        runs = _load("query_runs.json")
        for r in runs:
            if r.get("id") == run_id:
                r["status"] = "failed"
                r["error_code"] = "failed_precondition"
                r["error_message"] = "No documentation sources captured."
                r["latency_ms"] = latency_ms
                r["updated_at"] = now
                _save("query_runs.json", runs)
                break
        return _err("CONFLICT", "No documentation sources captured.")

    snippet_answer = (
        f"Doc-based snippet answer for: {topic.strip()} — {query.strip()}\n\n"
        f"Key snippet:\n"
        f"pseudo\n"
        f"# Use the official API/pattern described in the docs.\n"
        f"configure()\n"
        f"initialize()\n"
        f"run()\n"
        f"\n\n"
        f"Notes:\n"
        f"- Prefer the official docs for the exact syntax and version-specific behavior.\n"
    )

    output_file_id = None
    if save_to_path is not None:
        def _normalize_path(p):
            if not isinstance(p, str): return None
            if "\x00" in p: return None
            p = p.strip()
            if not p.startswith("/"): return None
            p = re.sub(r"/+", "/", p)
            if p != "/" and p.endswith("/"): p = p[:-1]
            for seg in p.split("/"):
                if seg in (".", ".."): return None
                if seg == "": continue
                if seg.strip() == "": return None
            return p

        npath = _normalize_path(save_to_path)
        if npath is None or npath == "/":
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsafe save_to_path.")

        parent_path = npath.rsplit("/", 1)[0] or "/"
        file_name = npath.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        fs_nodes = _load("fs_nodes.json")
        fs_versions = _load("fs_versions.json")
        parent = next((n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == parent_path and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
        if not parent:
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Parent directory does not exist.")
        if parent.get("node_type") != "directory":
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Parent path exists but is not a directory.")

        existing = next((n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == npath), None)
        if existing and existing.get("status") == "active" and existing.get("node_type") == "directory":
            return _err("CONFLICT", "A directory already exists at save_to_path.")
        if existing and existing.get("status") != "active":
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Cannot write to a deleted node.")

        max_bytes = ws.get("max_files_bytes", 0)
        total = 0
        for n in fs_nodes:
            if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("status") == "active" and n.get("node_type") == "file":
                sb = n.get("size_bytes") or 0
                if isinstance(sb, int) and sb > 0:
                    total += sb
        new_bytes = len(snippet_answer.encode("utf-8"))
        old_bytes = 0
        if existing and existing.get("status") == "active" and existing.get("node_type") == "file":
            ob = existing.get("size_bytes") or 0
            old_bytes = ob if isinstance(ob, int) and ob >= 0 else 0
        if total - old_bytes + new_bytes > max_bytes:
            return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Workspace filesystem quota exceeded.")

        if not existing:
            node_id = "vxs_fs_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
            existing = {
                "id": node_id,
                "workspace_id": workspace_id,
                "parent_id": parent.get("id"),
                "path": npath,
                "name": file_name,
                "node_type": "file",
                "status": "active",
                "size_bytes": 0,
                "permissions_octal": "0644",
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
                "last_accessed_at": None,
                "current_version_id": None,
            }
            fs_nodes.append(existing)

        ver_id = "vxs_fsv_" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
        sha = hashlib.sha256(snippet_answer.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        fs_versions.append({
            "id": ver_id,
            "fs_node_id": existing["id"],
            "created_by_run_id": run_id,
            "op_type": "save_tool",
            "encoding": "utf-8",
            "content_text": snippet_answer,
            "content_sha256": sha,
            "diff_from_prev": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        })
        existing["current_version_id"] = ver_id
        existing["size_bytes"] = new_bytes
        existing["updated_at"] = now
        output_file_id = existing["id"]
        _save("fs_versions.json", fs_versions)
        _save("fs_nodes.json", fs_nodes)

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    runs = _load("query_runs.json")
    final = None
    for r in runs:
        if r.get("id") == run_id:
            r["status"] = "succeeded"
            r["answer_text"] = snippet_answer
            r["output_file_id"] = output_file_id
            r["latency_ms"] = latency_ms
            r["updated_at"] = now
            final = r
            break
    _save("query_runs.json", runs)

    return {"query_run": final, "web_sources": sorted(sources_for_run, key=lambda x: x.get("rank") or 0)}

tool_schemas.name: generate_project_guidelines
tool_schemas.description: Generates a structured project-guidelines document from the provided tech_stack by searching for official docs and best practices and synthesizing them with the configured (or overridden) Vertex model, returning a persisted query-run record including the generated guidelines; if save_to_path is provided, the document is written to that workspace filesystem path and linked to the run. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed or tech_stack is empty, and raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace or use web search/model features, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED if rate/usage quotas are exceeded, and CONFLICT if save_to_path cannot be written due to an existing non-file entry at that path or another incompatible filesystem state.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to generate guidelines for.

tech_stack.description: List of technologies and versions to base the guidelines on (e.g., ['React 18', 'Node.js 20']).

model_name.description: Override the configured Vertex model name for this run.

save_to_path.description: If provided, writes the generated guidelines document into this workspace filesystem path and links it to the run.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def generate_project_guidelines(workspace_id, tech_stack, model_name=None, save_to_path=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib, fnmatch, difflib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0068000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0068000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        # deterministic-enough unique id with required prefix patterns: vxs_*_01H...
        seed = (datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f") + os.urandom(8).hex()).upper()
        # ensure A-Z0-9 only
        base = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "A", seed)
        return f"{prefix}_01H{base[:20]}"

    def _norm_path(p):
        if not isinstance(p, str) or p == "":
            return None, "path must be a non-empty string"
        if "\x00" in p:
            return None, "path contains null byte"
        p = p.strip()
        if p == "":
            return None, "path must be a non-empty string"
        if not p.startswith("/"):
            p = "/" + p
        # reject empty segments, '.', '..'
        parts = p.split("/")
        for seg in parts[1:]:
            if seg == "" or seg == "." or seg == "..":
                return None, "path must be normalized and must not contain empty segments, '.' or '..'"
        # collapse multiple slashes already rejected by empty segment check; so safe
        return p, None

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^vxs_wsp_01H[A-Z0-9]{15,}$", workspace_id or ""):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspace_id is malformed")
    if not isinstance(tech_stack, list) or len(tech_stack) < 1 or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in tech_stack):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tech_stack must be a non-empty array of strings")
    if model_name is not None and not isinstance(model_name, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "model_name must be a string")
    if save_to_path is not None and not isinstance(save_to_path, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "save_to_path must be a string")
    if save_to_path is not None:
        pnorm, perr = _norm_path(save_to_path)
        if perr:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", perr)
        save_to_path = pnorm

    # Load store
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    query_runs = _load("query_runs.json")
    web_sources = _load("web_sources.json")
    fs_nodes = _load("fs_nodes.json")
    fs_versions = _load("fs_versions.json")

    # Ambient auth: find any active api_key for active workspace matching workspace_id
    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)
    if not ws or ws.get("status") != "active":
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active workspace available for request")
    key = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and k.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if not key:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active API key available for request")

    # Model constraint
    effective_model = model_name if model_name is not None else ws.get("vertex_model")
    if effective_model != "gemini-1.5-pro-latest":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "model_name must be 'gemini-1.5-pro-latest'")

    # Web search gating for this tool
    if not ws.get("allow_web_search", False):
        # still record attempt? No request-log collection exists; but a run is the audit artifact here.
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Web search is disabled for this workspace", error_code="web_search_disabled")

    # Quota enforcement: creating a query_run increments requests_today and must not exceed limit
    limit = key.get("daily_request_limit_override")
    if limit is None:
        limit = ws.get("max_requests_per_day")
    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Configured daily request limit is invalid")
    try:
        req_today = int(key.get("requests_today", 0))
    except Exception:
        req_today = 0
    if req_today + 1 > limit:
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily request quota exceeded", error_code="quota_exceeded", limit=limit)

    # Increment quota counter and update key last_used_at
    now = _now()
    key["requests_today"] = req_today + 1
    key["last_used_at"] = now
    key["updated_at"] = now
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    # Create query_run
    run_id = _gen_id("vxs_run")
    run = {
        "id": run_id,
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "api_key_id": key.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "generate_project_guidelines",
        "status": "running",
        "query": None,
        "topic": None,
        "tech_stack": tech_stack,
        "use_web_search": True,
        "model_name": effective_model,
        "prompt_tokens": None,
        "completion_tokens": None,
        "latency_ms": None,
        "answer_text": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "output_file_id": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    query_runs.append(run)
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    # Create at least one web_sources row before succeeded
    src_id = _gen_id("vxs_src")
    q = " ".join(tech_stack)
    url = "https://developers.google.com/search"
    ws_row = {
        "id": src_id,
        "query_run_id": run_id,
        "rank": 1,
        "url": url,
        "title": "Official documentation search (simulated)",
        "snippet": f"Searched official docs and best practices for: {q}",
        "is_official_doc": True,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    # uniqueness (query_run_id, rank)
    if any(s.get("query_run_id") == run_id and s.get("rank") == 1 for s in web_sources):
        # extremely unlikely; fix by choosing next rank
        r = 1
        while any(s.get("query_run_id") == run_id and s.get("rank") == r for s in web_sources):
            r += 1
        ws_row["rank"] = r
    web_sources.append(ws_row)
    _save("web_sources.json", web_sources)

    # Generate guidelines (deterministic structured text, no external calls)
    def _guidelines(ts):
        lines = []
        lines.append("# Project Guidelines")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Tech stack")
        for item in ts:
            lines.append(f"- {item}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Engineering standards")
        lines.append("- Prefer clear, tested, documented code over cleverness.")
        lines.append("- Enforce formatting and linting in CI.")
        lines.append("- Use semantic versioning and changelogs for releases.")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Documentation & references")
        lines.append(f"- Source 1 (official docs): {url}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Security & reliability")
        lines.append("- Keep dependencies updated; monitor CVEs.")
        lines.append("- Validate inputs; avoid secrets in logs; use least-privilege credentials.")
        lines.append("- Add observability: structured logs, traces, and metrics.")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Testing")
        lines.append("- Unit tests for business logic; integration tests for boundaries.")
        lines.append("- Use deterministic fixtures; avoid flaky tests.")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Deployment")
        lines.append("- Use repeatable builds; pin toolchain versions; run migrations safely.")
        lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    answer_text = _guidelines(tech_stack)

    # Optionally write to filesystem (save_tool semantics)
    output_file = None
    if save_to_path is not None:
        # Path safety already validated+normalized.
        # Ensure parent directory exists (implicit create not specified; require existing dir unless root?) - schema requires file parent_id not null.
        parent_path = "/" + "/".join(save_to_path.strip("/").split("/")[:-1]) if "/" in save_to_path.strip("/") else "/"
        if parent_path == "":
            parent_path = "/"
        parent_node = next((n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == parent_path and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
        if not parent_node or parent_node.get("node_type") != "directory":
            # fail the run; do not write fs_versions
            run["status"] = "failed"
            run["error_code"] = "invalid_path"
            run["error_message"] = "Parent directory does not exist"
            run["answer_text"] = answer_text
            run["updated_at"] = _now()
            run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Parent directory does not exist", run_id=run_id)

        # Enforce unique(workspace_id, path), create or overwrite file
        existing = next((n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == save_to_path), None)
        if existing and existing.get("status") == "active" and existing.get("node_type") == "directory":
            run["status"] = "failed"
            run["error_code"] = "path_is_directory"
            run["error_message"] = "Destination path is a directory"
            run["answer_text"] = answer_text
            run["updated_at"] = _now()
            run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Destination path is a directory", run_id=run_id)

        # compute size/quota
        content_bytes = answer_text.encode("utf-8")
        new_size = len(content_bytes)
        # total active file sizes
        active_files = [n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("status") == "active" and n.get("node_type") == "file"]
        total = 0
        for n in active_files:
            try:
                total += int(n.get("size_bytes", 0))
            except Exception:
                total += 0
        old_size = 0
        if existing and existing.get("status") == "active" and existing.get("node_type") == "file":
            try:
                old_size = int(existing.get("size_bytes", 0))
            except Exception:
                old_size = 0
        if total - old_size + new_size > int(ws.get("max_files_bytes", 0)):
            run["status"] = "failed"
            run["error_code"] = "quota_exceeded"
            run["error_message"] = "Workspace filesystem quota exceeded"
            run["answer_text"] = answer_text
            run["updated_at"] = _now()
            run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
            return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Workspace filesystem quota exceeded", run_id=run_id)

        # upsert fs_node
        if not existing or existing.get("status") != "active":
            # create new file node
            node_id = _gen_id("vxs_fs")
            basename = save_to_path.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
            node = {
                "id": node_id,
                "workspace_id": workspace_id,
                "parent_id": parent_node.get("id"),
                "path": save_to_path,
                "name": basename,
                "node_type": "file",
                "status": "active",
                "size_bytes": 0,
                "permissions_octal": "0644",
                "created_at": _now(),
                "updated_at": _now(),
                "last_accessed_at": None,
                "current_version_id": None,
            }
            # uniqueness check (even against deleted nodes as per unique constraint)
            if any(n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == save_to_path and n.get("id") != node_id for n in fs_nodes):
                run["status"] = "failed"
                run["error_code"] = "path_conflict"
                run["error_message"] = "Destination path already exists"
                run["answer_text"] = answer_text
                run["updated_at"] = _now()
                run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
                _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
                return _err("CONFLICT", "Destination path already exists", run_id=run_id)
            fs_nodes.append(node)
            existing = node

        # create version
        ver_id = _gen_id("vxs_ver")
        sha = hashlib.sha256(content_bytes).hexdigest()
        ver = {
            "id": ver_id,
            "fs_node_id": existing.get("id"),
            "created_by_run_id": run_id,
            "op_type": "save_tool",
            "encoding": "utf-8",
            "content_text": answer_text,
            "content_sha256": sha,
            "diff_from_prev": None,
            "created_at": _now(),
            "updated_at": None,  # set equal below for immutability rule
        }
        ver["updated_at"] = ver["created_at"]
        fs_versions.append(ver)
        _save("fs_versions.json", fs_versions)

        # update node pointers
        existing["current_version_id"] = ver_id
        existing["size_bytes"] = new_size
        existing["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("fs_nodes.json", fs_nodes)

        output_file = existing
        run["output_file_id"] = existing.get("id")

    # Succeed run: ensure web_sources exist when use_web_search=true
    if run.get("use_web_search") and not any(s.get("query_run_id") == run_id for s in web_sources):
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "missing_sources"
        run["error_message"] = "No web sources captured for web-search run"
    else:
        run["status"] = "succeeded"
        run["answer_text"] = answer_text

    run["updated_at"] = _now()
    run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    return {
        "run": run,
        "web_sources": [s for s in web_sources if s.get("query_run_id") == run_id],
        "output_file": output_file,
    }

tool_schemas.name: read_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the workspace filesystem. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file within the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose filesystem will be read.

path.description: Workspace-local filesystem path of the file to read.

encoding.description: Text encoding to use when decoding file content (if omitted, server auto-detects).

tool_schemas.name: read_multiple_files_content
tool_schemas.description: Reads the contents of each requested file path from the workspace filesystem and returns an array of per-path results (including the path and decoded content when readable), using the provided encoding or server auto-detection per file; failures are reported per item rather than aborting the whole call. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed, paths is empty, or any path is an empty string, and raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace/files, and returns per-file NOT_FOUND for missing paths and CONFLICT for paths that resolve to non-file entries (e.g., directories) or otherwise cannot be read as a file.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose filesystem will be read.

paths.description: List of workspace-local filesystem paths of the files to read.

encoding.description: Text encoding to use when decoding file content (if omitted, server auto-detects per file).

tool_schemas.name: write_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Creates or overwrites the file at path in the workspace filesystem with the provided text content, recording encoding (if provided) and attributing the change to created_by_run_id when supplied, and returns the resulting file record/version metadata for auditing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id or created_by_run_id (when provided) do not match the expected formats or path is empty, and raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or created_by_run_id is provided but does not correspond to a run in that workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot write to the workspace/filesystem, and CONFLICT if the target path cannot be written because it refers to an existing non-file entry (e.g., a directory) or an incompatible filesystem state prevents the overwrite.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose filesystem will be modified.

path.description: Workspace-local filesystem path of the file to create or overwrite.

content.description: Full new text content to write to the file.

encoding.description: Text encoding label to record for the written content (e.g., 'utf-8').

created_by_run_id.description: Query run id to attribute this write operation to for audit logging and versioning.

tool_schemas.name: edit_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Applies the provided line-based replacement edits to a text file in the workspace filesystem (or returns the computed diff only when dry_run is true), and returns the updated content and/or diff along with versioning/audit metadata attributed to run_id when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/run_id (when provided) do not match expected formats, path is empty, or edits is empty or contains invalid entries, and raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or run_id is provided but does not correspond to a run in that workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the file, CONFLICT if the path does not refer to an editable text file (e.g., missing, directory, or encoding/content cannot be edited as text) or if required edit matches cannot be applied due to the current file state.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the text file to edit.

edits.description: Line-based replacement edits to apply in order.

oldText.description: Exact text to find (fallbacks to trimmed line-by-line match if not found).

newText.description: Replacement text to insert in place of oldText.

run_id.description: Optional originating query run id to attribute this edit for versioning/audit.

encoding.description: Text encoding label for stored content (e.g., utf-8).

dry_run.description: If true, compute and return the diff without persisting changes.

tool_schemas.name: create_directory
tool_schemas.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists in the workspace filesystem. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation (like mkdir -p). If the directory already exists, this operation will succeed silently. Perfect for setting up directory structures for projects.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path to create (supports nested paths like mkdir -p).

parents.description: If true, create any missing parent directories (mkdir -p behavior).

run_id.description: Optional originating query run id to attribute this operation for audit.

tool_schemas.name: list_directory_contents
tool_schemas.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories directly within a specified path in the workspace filesystem. Results clearly distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes. This tool is essential for understanding directory structure and finding specific files within a directory. Does not list recursively.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

include_deleted.description: If true, include entries marked deleted in the virtual filesystem.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_directory_tree
tool_schemas.description: Returns a recursive JSON tree for the workspace-local filesystem rooted at `path`, where each node includes `name` and `type`, and directories include a `children` array; recursion stops at `max_depth` (0 returns only the root node) and `include_deleted` controls whether deleted entries appear. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id` or `path` is malformed or `max_depth` is outside 0–50, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or `path` does not resolve to a directory (or resolves only to a deleted entry when `include_deleted` is false). Raises CONFLICT if the path cannot be traversed due to an incompatible node type encountered during traversal (e.g., a file where a directory segment is required).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path to render as a recursive tree.

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth (0 returns only the root entry).

include_deleted.description: If true, include entries marked deleted in the virtual filesystem.

tool_schemas.name: move_file_or_directory
tool_schemas.description: Move or rename files and directories within the workspace filesystem. Can move items between directories and rename them in a single operation. If the destination path already exists, the operation will likely fail (OS-dependent).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

source_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file or directory to move/rename.

destination_path.description: Workspace-relative destination path (including new name if renaming).

run_id.description: Optional originating query run id to attribute this operation for audit.

tool_schemas.name: search_filesystem
tool_schemas.description: Recursively searches from `start_path` for files/directories whose base name contains `pattern` (case-insensitive), optionally filtered by `node_type` and excluding any paths matching `exclude_globs`, and returns up to `limit` matches plus a `cursor` when more results are available (pass the cursor to continue). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are missing/invalid (including `limit` not in 1–1000 or `node_type` outside the allowed enum), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or `start_path` does not exist or is not a directory. Raises CONFLICT if the provided `cursor` is invalid/expired or does not correspond to the same workspace and search criteria.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

start_path.description: Workspace-relative directory path to start recursive search from.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive partial name to match against file/directory names.

exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns (workspace-relative) to exclude from search results.

node_type.description: Restrict matches to files, directories, or both.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_filesystem_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for the filesystem entry at `path` (file or directory), including type, timestamps, size (for files), and permissions, and honors `include_deleted` to allow inspecting entries marked deleted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id`/`path` is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks workspace access, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace or entry does not exist (or the entry is deleted and `include_deleted` is false).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the virtual filesystem.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to a file or directory to inspect.

include_deleted.description: If true, allow returning info for entries marked deleted.

tool_schemas.name: save_generate_project_guidelines
tool_schemas.description: Generates project guidelines for the provided `tech_stack` using the selected model (workspace default or `model_name` override) and optional Google web search (`use_web_search`), then writes the generated content to `output_path` in the specified workspace and returns the saved file reference and associated run record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including empty `tech_stack` or invalid `output_path`), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot run in or write to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if model/search quotas are exceeded and CONFLICT if `output_path` cannot be written due to an incompatible existing node at that path (e.g., a directory where a file is required).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to run in and to save the output file under.

tech_stack.description: List of technologies/frameworks to base the guidelines on.

output_path.description: Workspace-relative file path where generated guidelines will be saved.

use_web_search.description: Whether to use Google web search while generating guidelines.

model_name.description: Vertex model name override (defaults to workspace-configured model, typically gemini-1.5-pro-latest).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def save_generate_project_guidelines(workspace_id, tech_stack, output_path, use_web_search=None, model_name=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib, secrets
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0068000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0068000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _today_utc():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().date().isoformat()

    def _norm_path(p):
        if not isinstance(p, str) or len(p) < 1:
            return None, "path must be a non-empty string"
        if "\x00" in p:
            return None, "path must not contain null bytes"
        p = p.strip()
        if not p.startswith("/"):
            p = "/" + p
        while "//" in p:
            p = p.replace("//", "/")
        if len(p) > 1 and p.endswith("/"):
            p = p[:-1]
        segs = p.split("/")[1:]
        if any(s == "" for s in segs):
            return None, "path must not contain empty segments"
        if any(s == ".." for s in segs):
            return None, "path must not contain '..'"
        if any(s == "." for s in segs):
            segs = [s for s in segs if s != "."]
            p = "/" + "/".join(segs) if segs else "/"
        return p, None

    def _parent(p):
        if p == "/":
            return None
        q = p.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
        return q if q else "/"

    def _basename(p):
        return "/" if p == "/" else p.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

    def _new_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        return prefix + "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(20))

    def _sum_active_file_bytes(fs_nodes_rows):
        s = 0
        for n in fs_nodes_rows:
            if n.get("status") == "active" and n.get("node_type") == "file":
                try:
                    s += int(n.get("size_bytes") or 0)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return s

    # Load stores
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    query_runs = _load("query_runs.json")
    web_sources = _load("web_sources.json")
    fs_nodes = _load("fs_nodes.json")
    fs_versions = _load("fs_versions.json")

    # Validate basic inputs
    if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^vxs_wsp_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", workspace_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspace_id is malformed")
    if not isinstance(tech_stack, list) or len(tech_stack) < 1 or any(not isinstance(x, str) or not x.strip() for x in tech_stack):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tech_stack must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings")
    op, e = _norm_path(output_path)
    if e:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"output_path invalid: {e}")
    if op == "/":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "output_path must be a file path, not '/'")
    if use_web_search is None:
        use_web_search = False
    if not isinstance(use_web_search, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "use_web_search must be boolean")
    if model_name is not None and not isinstance(model_name, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "model_name must be a string")

    # Auth: must have active key and active workspace
    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)
    if ws is None:
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "workspace not found")
    if ws.get("status") != "active":
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "workspace is not active")
    key = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and k.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if key is None:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "no active API key available for workspace")

    # Model selection constraint
    chosen_model = model_name or ws.get("vertex_model")
    if chosen_model != "gemini-1.5-pro-latest":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "model_name is not allowed", allowed_models=["gemini-1.5-pro-latest"])

    # Web search gating (generate_project_guidelines is gated per rules)
    if use_web_search and not ws.get("allow_web_search"):
        # Option: create failed run or reject. We'll create failed run? Rule allows either for quota; for gating says "run must fail"
        # We'll insert a failed run (counts towards quota because a run was created). But rule says missing required inputs must not start a run.
        # Inputs are valid; create failed run is acceptable.
        pass

    # Quota enforcement on creating a query_runs row
    # Rolling counter reset daily (UTC): simplistic reset when last_used_at day != today
    today = _today_utc()
    last_used_at = key.get("last_used_at")
    if isinstance(last_used_at, str) and len(last_used_at) >= 10:
        last_day = last_used_at[:10]
    else:
        last_day = None
    if last_day != today:
        key["requests_today"] = 0

    limit_daily = key.get("daily_request_limit_override")
    if limit_daily is None:
        limit_daily = ws.get("max_requests_per_day")
    try:
        limit_daily = int(limit_daily)
    except Exception:
        limit_daily = 0

    if not isinstance(key.get("requests_today"), int):
        try:
            key["requests_today"] = int(key.get("requests_today") or 0)
        except Exception:
            key["requests_today"] = 0

    if key["requests_today"] + 1 > limit_daily:
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "daily request quota exceeded")

    # Create query run (queued -> running -> succeeded/failed)
    now = _now()
    run_id = _new_id("vxs_run_")
    run = {
        "id": run_id,
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "api_key_id": key.get("id"),
        "tool_name": "save_generate_project_guidelines",
        "status": "queued",
        "query": None,
        "topic": None,
        "tech_stack": tech_stack,
        "use_web_search": bool(use_web_search),
        "model_name": chosen_model,
        "prompt_tokens": None,
        "completion_tokens": None,
        "latency_ms": None,
        "answer_text": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "output_file_id": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }

    # Persist run creation and quota increment
    key["requests_today"] += 1
    key["last_used_at"] = now
    key["updated_at"] = now
    query_runs.append(run)
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    # Start run
    run["status"] = "running"
    run["updated_at"] = _now()
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    # Web search disabled gate -> fail run
    if use_web_search and not ws.get("allow_web_search"):
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "web_search_disabled"
        run["error_message"] = "Web search is disabled for this workspace."
        run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        run["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        return {"run": run, "file": None}

    # Generate guidelines content (offline deterministic synthesis)
    # Note: In real service, this calls Vertex. Here we generate a structured template.
    lines = []
    lines.append("# Project Guidelines")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Tech stack")
    for t in tech_stack:
        lines.append(f"- {t.strip()}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Conventions")
    lines.append("- Keep code modular and testable.")
    lines.append("- Prefer explicit types and clear interfaces.")
    lines.append("- Document public APIs and non-obvious decisions.")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Quality gates")
    lines.append("- Linting and formatting enforced in CI.")
    lines.append("- Unit tests required for new functionality.")
    lines.append("- Security review for auth/crypto/network changes.")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Versioning & releases")
    lines.append("- Use semantic versioning where applicable.")
    lines.append("- Keep a changelog for user-facing changes.")
    lines.append("")
    if use_web_search:
        lines.append("## Notes")
        lines.append("- This run was configured to use web search grounding.")
        lines.append("")
    content = "\n".join(lines)

    # Source capture rule: if use_web_search=true then at least 1 web_sources row must be created before success.
    if use_web_search:
        ws_id = _new_id("vxs_src_")
        web_sources.append({
            "id": ws_id,
            "query_run_id": run_id,
            "rank": 1,
            "url": "http://example.com/grounding-placeholder",
            "title": "Grounding placeholder",
            "snippet": "Offline datastore mode: placeholder source record to satisfy source capture rule.",
            "is_official_doc": False,
            "created_at": _now(),
            "updated_at": _now()
        })
        _save("web_sources.json", web_sources)

    # Write file as save_tool version
    # Ensure parent directory exists and is active directory
    parent_path = _parent(op)
    if parent_path is None:
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "validation_error"
        run["error_message"] = "Invalid output_path parent."
        run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        run["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        return {"run": run, "file": None}

    parent_node = next((n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == parent_path and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if parent_node is None or parent_node.get("node_type") != "directory":
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "not_found"
        run["error_message"] = "Parent directory for output_path not found."
        run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        run["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        return {"run": run, "file": None}

    # Create or reuse file node (must be file; if directory exists at path -> conflict)
    existing = next((n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == op and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if existing is not None and existing.get("node_type") != "file":
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "conflict"
        run["error_message"] = "A directory already exists at output_path."
        run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        run["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        return {"run": run, "file": None}

    # Enforce workspace max_files_bytes
    encoded = content.encode("utf-8")
    new_size = len(encoded)
    current_total = _sum_active_file_bytes([n for n in fs_nodes if n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id])
    old_size = 0
    if existing is not None:
        try:
            old_size = int(existing.get("size_bytes") or 0)
        except Exception:
            old_size = 0
    try:
        max_bytes = int(ws.get("max_files_bytes"))
    except Exception:
        max_bytes = 0
    projected = current_total - old_size + new_size
    if projected > max_bytes:
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "quota_exceeded"
        run["error_message"] = "Workspace file storage quota exceeded."
        run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        run["updated_at"] = _now()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        return {"run": run, "file": None}

    # Create file node if needed
    if existing is None:
        node_id = _new_id("vxs_fs_")
        file_node = {
            "id": node_id,
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "parent_id": parent_node.get("id"),
            "path": op,
            "name": _basename(op),
            "node_type": "file",
            "status": "active",
            "size_bytes": 0,
            "permissions_octal": "0644",
            "created_at": _now(),
            "updated_at": _now(),
            "last_accessed_at": None,
            "current_version_id": None
        }
        fs_nodes.append(file_node)
    else:
        file_node = existing

    # Create version row
    ver_id = _new_id("vxs_fsv_")
    sha = hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
    ver_now = _now()
    version = {
        "id": ver_id,
        "fs_node_id": file_node.get("id"),
        "created_by_run_id": run_id,
        "op_type": "save_tool",
        "encoding": "utf-8",
        "content_text": content,
        "content_sha256": sha,
        "diff_from_prev": None,
        "created_at": ver_now,
        "updated_at": ver_now
    }
    fs_versions.append(version)

    # Update file node pointers and size
    file_node["current_version_id"] = ver_id
    file_node["size_bytes"] = new_size
    file_node["updated_at"] = _now()

    _save("fs_versions.json", fs_versions)
    _save("fs_nodes.json", fs_nodes)

    # Ensure source capture rule before succeeded
    if use_web_search:
        has_source = any(s for s in web_sources if s.get("query_run_id") == run_id)
        if not has_source:
            run["status"] = "failed"
            run["error_code"] = "validation_error"
            run["error_message"] = "use_web_search requires at least one captured web source."
            run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            run["updated_at"] = _now()
            _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
            return {"run": run, "file": None}

    # Complete run
    run["answer_text"] = content
    run["output_file_id"] = file_node.get("id")
    run["status"] = "succeeded"
    run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    run["updated_at"] = _now()
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    return {
        "run": run,

            p = "/" + p

            p = p.replace("//", "/")

            p = p[:-1]

            return None, "path must not contain empty segments"

            return None, "path must not contain '..'"

            continue
        ws = ws_by_id.get(k.get("workspace_id"))
        if not ws or ws.get("status") != "active":
            continue

            continue

        break

        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No authorized workspace/api_key available for web-search run")

    requests_today = key.get("requests_today")

        requests_today = 0
    if requests_today + 1 > limit:
        _audit("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", workspace_id_ctx=workspace_id, api_key_id=key_id)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Quota exceeded for this API key/workspace")

        "answer_text": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "output_file_id": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    # Write to output_path:

    # - If it's a file path, write that file (create/overwrite).
    # This fixes prior defect where directories caused CONFLICT.
    existing_at_path = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == outp and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
    target_path = outp
    if existing_at_path and existing_at_path.get("node_type") == "directory":

        target_path = (outp.rstrip("/") if outp != "/" else "/") + ("/" if outp != "/" else "") + f"{safe_name}.txt"
    # If target_path exists as directory (e.g., outp="/" and safe_name appends), re-check
    existing_target = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == target_path and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if existing_target and existing_target.get("node_type") == "directory":
        # fallback filename with run id
        target_path = (outp.rstrip("/") if outp != "/" else "/") + ("/" if outp != "/" else "") + f"{run_id}.txt"
        existing_target = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == target_path and n.get("status") == "active"), None)

    # Parent must exist and be directory (unless writing to /<file> under root dir existing as '/')
    def _parent(p):
        if p == "/":
            return None
        q = p.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
        return q if q else "/"
    def _basename(p):
        return "/" if p == "/" else p.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

    parent_path = _parent(target_path)
    if parent_path is None:

        run["error_message"] = "output_path cannot be '/'"

    parent_node = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == parent_path and n.get("status") == "active" and n.get("node_type") == "directory"), None)
    if parent_node is None:

        run["updated_at"] = _now_iso()

    # Create or overwrite file node at target_path

            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "parent_id": parent_node.get("id"),
            "path": target_path,
            "name": _basename(target_path),

            "status": "active",

            "updated_at": now,
            "last_accessed_at": now,
            "current_version_id": None
        }
        fs_nodes.append(file_node)
    else:

            run["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
            run["error_message"] = "A directory exists at target output file path"
            run["updated_at"] = _now_iso()

            _audit("CONFLICT", workspace_id_ctx=workspace_id, api_key_id=key_id, run_id=run_id)

    ver_id = _new_id("vxs_fsv_")
    sha = hashlib.sha256(answer_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    fs_versions.append({
        "id": ver_id,
        "fs_node_id": file_node.get("id"),
        "created_by_run_id": run_id,
        "op_type": "save_tool",
        "encoding": "utf-8",
        "content_text": answer_text,
        "content_sha256": sha,
        "diff_from_prev": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    file_node["current_version_id"] = ver_id
    file_node["size_bytes"] = len(answer_text.encode("utf-8"))
    file_node["updated_at"] = now

    # Finish run: require at least 1 web_source (we already inserted one)
    run["answer_text"] = answer_text
    run["output_file_id"] = file_node.get("id")
    run["status"] = "succeeded"
    run["updated_at"] = now
    run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

    _save("fs_nodes.json", fs_nodes)
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    _audit("OK", workspace_id_ctx=workspace_id, api_key_id=key_id, run_id=run_id)
    return {

        "output": {"fs_node": file_node, "version_id": ver_id, "path": target_path},

    }

        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _audit(status, workspace_id_ctx=None, api_key_id=None, run_id=None, **extra):

            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            **extra
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    def _norm_path(p):
        if not isinstance(p, str) or not p.strip():
            return None, "output_path must be a non-empty string"
        if "\x00" in p:
            return None, "path must not contain null bytes"
        p = p.strip()
        if not p.startswith("/"):
            p = "/" + p
        while "//" in p:
            p = p.replace("//", "/")
        if len(p) > 1 and p.endswith("/"):
            p = p[:-1]
        segs = p.split("/")[1:]
        if any(s == "" for s in segs):
            return None, "path must not contain empty segments"
        if any(s == ".." for s in segs):
            return None, "path must not contain '..'"
        if any(s == "." for s in segs):
            segs = [s for s in segs if s != "."]
            p = "/" + "/".join(segs) if segs else "/"

    workspace_id = ws.get("id")

    requests_today = key.get("requests_today")

        "topic": None,
        "tech_stack": None,

    key["updated_at"] = now

    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    answer_text = f"Q: {query}\n\nA:\n(offline) Direct model answer (no web search).\n"

    # Output path semantics: if output_path is an existing directory, write inside it.
    existing_at_path = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == outp and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
    target_path = outp

        run["updated_at"] = _now_iso()

    parent_node = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == parent_path and n.get("status") == "active" and n.get("node_type") == "directory"), None)
    if parent_node is None:
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "NOT_FOUND"
        run["error_message"] = "Parent directory does not exist"
        run["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        _audit("NOT_FOUND", workspace_id_ctx=workspace_id, api_key_id=key_id, run_id=run_id)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Parent directory does not exist", run_id=run_id)

    existing_target = next((n for n in fs_nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and n.get("path") == target_path and n.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if existing_target and existing_target.get("node_type") == "directory":
        run["status"] = "failed"
        run["error_code"] = "CONFLICT"
        run["error_message"] = "A directory exists at output_path"
        run["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
        _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)
        _audit("CONFLICT", workspace_id_ctx=workspace_id, api_key_id=key_id, run_id=run_id)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "A directory exists at output_path", run_id=run_id)

    file_node = existing_target
    if file_node is None:
        file_node = {
            "id": _new_id("vxs_fs_"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "parent_id": parent_node.get("id"),
            "path": target_path,
            "name": _basename(target_path),
            "node_type": "file",
            "status": "active",
            "size_bytes": 0,
            "permissions_octal": "0644",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
            "last_accessed_at": now,
            "current_version_id": None
        }
        fs_nodes.append(file_node)

    ver_id = _new_id("vxs_fsv_")
    sha = hashlib.sha256(answer_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    fs_versions.append({
        "id": ver_id,
        "fs_node_id": file_node.get("id"),
        "created_by_run_id": run_id,
        "op_type": "save_tool",
        "encoding": "utf-8",
        "content_text": answer_text,
        "content_sha256": sha,
        "diff_from_prev": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    file_node["current_version_id"] = ver_id
    file_node["size_bytes"] = len(answer_text.encode("utf-8"))
    file_node["updated_at"] = now

    run["answer_text"] = answer_text
    run["output_file_id"] = file_node.get("id")
    run["status"] = "succeeded"
    run["updated_at"] = now
    run["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

    _save("fs_versions.json", fs_versions)
    _save("fs_nodes.json", fs_nodes)
    _save("query_runs.json", query_runs)

    _audit("OK", workspace_id_ctx=workspace_id, api_key_id=key_id, run_id=run_id)
